meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 gtars 处理基因组区间数据:检测区域重叠、生成覆盖率轨道、把基因组区域转成机器学习 token、获取参考序列,以及拆分和评分片段文件。
howto.when: 当你处理 BED 文件等基因组区间数据,或要做重叠检测、token 化等任务时。

say.text: 帮我把这两个 BED 文件的重叠区域找出来,并导出结果。
say.note: 会调用 gtars 做区间重叠检测并输出 BED。

say.text: 用这个 fragments 文件生成 BigWig 覆盖率轨道。
say.note: 调用 uniwig 生成覆盖率文件。

say.text: 把训练区间的 BED 文件转成机器学习 token。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use gtars to work with genomic interval data: detect overlaps between regions, generate coverage tracks, tokenize genomic regions for ML, fetch reference sequences, and split or score fragment files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with genomic interval data such as BED files, or ask for overlap detection, tokenization, and similar tasks.

say_en.text: Find the overlaps between these two BED files and export the result.
say_en.note: Runs gtars overlap detection and outputs BED.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from this fragments file.
say_en.note: Uses uniwig to produce a coverage file.

say_en.text: Convert the training-region BED file into machine-learning tokens.
say_en.note: Uses TreeTokenizer to tokenize genomic regions.
